import concurrent.futures,hashlib,json,os,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
source=root/'s05_prepare_hard_functions.wl'
digest=hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
snapshot=root/'s05_cache'/('s05_source_'+digest+'.wl')
snapshot.write_bytes(source.read_bytes())
channels=['Hqq','Hgg','Hqqbar','Hqqprime','Hgq','Hqg']
def run(channel):
    env=os.environ.copy();env.update(SIDIS_S05_MODE='export',SIDIS_CHANNEL=channel)
    path=root/'s05_cache'/(channel+'_run.log')
    with path.open('w') as log:
        p=subprocess.Popen([env['WOLFRAM_KERNEL'],'-noprompt','-script',str(source)],env=env,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True)
        for line in p.stdout:
            log.write(line);log.flush()
            print(channel+' '+line.rstrip(),flush=True)
        status=p.wait()
    assert status==0,(channel,status)
    value=json.loads((root/'s05_cache'/(channel+'_result')).read_text())
    assert value['Status']=='ExportComplete'
    assert all(f['ProducerSHA256']==digest and f['PaxABIFieldUnused'] for f in value['Functions'])
    return channel
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as pool:
    completed=list(pool.map(run,channels))
assert completed==channels
print('S05_SUCCESS all channels',flush=True)
